description: Join us any Thursday evening from 6:30-8pm and get the word out that District 35 has an excellent choice on the ballot this year - Sarah Mertens! You’ll be making the calls from your phone or PC. Google Voice can be used to make calls, if you set it up beforehand.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Citizens for Sarah Mertens
title: Virtual Phone Bank — Citizens for Sarah Mertens
